title: Slachtofferenquete WODC, 1979
authors: Dijk, J.J.M. van, Steinmetz, C.H.D., Ministerie van justitie, Wetenschappelijk onderzoek- en documentatiecentrum, WODC * Den Haag (primary investigator)
contributors: Nederlands instituut voor de publieke opinie en het marktonderzoek, NIPO * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Determining number of Dutch citizens who fell victim to crime/ reasons for ( not ) notifying police of crimes. Number and nature of crimes / theft of bike, moped / theft from car/ theft of car / theft of purse and amount of money lost / burglary / sexual violence / physical violence kind and severity of injuries / when walking ever hit by moped, car by no fault of oneself/ kind and severity of injuries/ damage done in money/ other party drove away after accident without identifying himself / wilfully committed damage to properties/ damage done in money / theft of cheques, postal credit cards / reasons for ( not ) notifying police of crimes, signed official record. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ religion/ consumption of durables
